items.question: How quickly can you arrive for service?
items.answer: For urgent calls we aim to be at your door within a couple of hours. For scheduled work we book a slot that fits your day, and you always get a confirmed arrival window.

items.question: Are you licensed and insured?
items.answer: Yes. Every electrician on our team is fully licensed, certified, and insured, so your home or business is protected on every job.

items.question: How does your hourly pricing work?
items.answer: Our standard service rate is billed transparently by the hour, with no hidden fees. You approve any parts or extra work before we start.

items.question: Do you provide quotes for large projects?
items.answer: Absolutely. For renovations, rewiring, or commercial installations we provide a detailed custom quote with a clear scope and timeline.

items.question: Do you offer emergency electrical services?
items.answer: Yes, we offer fast-response emergency support for outages, sparking outlets, and other urgent electrical issues, day or night.

cta.title: Need urgent electrical help?
cta.subtitle: We respond quickly to urgent electrical issues, delivering safe and reliable solutions when you need them most.

footer.tagline: Ohmly is a professional electrician service built for fast response, clear pricing, and trust-building work that turns visitors into customers.
